descriptor.name: Wisconsin Statewide Parcel Map Database V12 — statewide
descriptor.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational; users choose their source and intended use.
descriptor.operator: Wisconsin State Cartographer's Office / Wisconsin Land Information Program (Department of Administration); county parcel data
descriptor.scope: Wisconsin V12 statewide parcel database, all 72 counties. STATEID is the statewide key: the county PARCELFIPS followed by the county PARCELID.
caveats: STATEID is derived from the county PARCELID and changes if a county renumbers.
Same endpoint as us-wi-madison-parcels (CONAME=DANE, key PARCELID under US-WI-MADISON-DANE-); Dane County parcels would exist under both namespaces.
Layer also publishes owner, address and assessment fields, which are not requested.
descriptor.attribution: Wisconsin State Cartographer's Office, Wisconsin Land Information Program and Wisconsin counties. Adapted to WGS84.

jurisdiction.basis: Layer description: final deliverable of the Version 12 Statewide Parcel Map Database Project aggregating county parcel data; all 72 county names present on 2026-10-12 (73 CONAME values; the extra one is the label MENOMONIE).
